chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffi, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, said:

Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) said: 'I will be killed by poison, wrongfully. Whoever visits me, recognizing my rightfulness, God will forgive him what preceded of his sin and what followed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Rida (a.s.) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (a.s.) foretells his martyrdom by poisoning, stating that those who visit him with knowledge of his status and rightfulness will have their past and future sins forgiven by God. This narration, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, underscores the Shia concept of *al-irfan bi-haqqihi* (knowing his rightfulness) as the key criterion for the validity of visitation (*ziyarah*), linking physical pilgrimage to spiritual recognition of the Imam's divine station.
